goal: Diagnose why the zip failed validation and fix what's genuinely broken. Root cause: neither pmcro-trail nor pmcro-orchestrator had a .claude-plugin/plugin.json -- only a plain plugin.json at plugin root, which claude plugin validate accepted but Cowork's upload validator requires the .claude-plugin/ location specifically. Separately, the zip itself was of the whole repo root (a 2-plugin marketplace), not a single plugin, so it could never pass a single-plugin upload regardless.

steps.action: add .claude-plugin/plugin.json to both plugins, mirroring the root plugin.json content
re-run claude plugin validate on both to confirm the fix, and fix any new warnings surfaced
zip each plugin folder individually so there's something that will actually pass single-plugin upload

success_criteria: two per-plugin zips exist, each rooted at a folder containing .claude-plugin/plugin.json directly
out_of_scope: fixing the legacy repo's own broken manifest (separate, already reported, not touched this cycle)
